title: Connect Bird to Vercel
summary: Connect your Bird workspace to Vercel. The integration creates your API key and saves it with the regional endpoint in your selected projects.
body_markdown:
You can now connect your Bird account to Vercel and let the integration set up your API credentials. It creates a Bird API key and saves it with your workspace's regional API endpoint in your selected Vercel projects, so you don't have to copy either value between dashboards.


During setup, choose your Bird workspace, Vercel projects, and Preview or Production environment. Bird saves` BIRD_API_KEY` and` BIRD_API_BASE_URL` as encrypted environment variables. Finish the installation in Vercel, then redeploy your app to use them.


[Connect Bird to Vercel](https://vercel.com/marketplace/bird) .
